heading: Check the source
captions:

heading: Find one fact
captions:
The leaflet called for a bus boycott
on 5 December 1955.

heading: Name the makers

heading: Ask why it was made

heading: Keep a limit
captions:
A call to act does not prove
that every person joined.

heading: Use your own judgement
